title: Critical Splash Screens
description: Displays a per-character static screen overlay (with optional sound) on natural 20 crits (or a lowered crit threshold, auto-detected or manually overridden) and natural 1 fumbles (attacks, death saves, ability checks, skill checks) for dnd5e, via Sequencer, and plays a random death sound when a token dies. Universal crit/fumble sound folders act as fallbacks for characters with no custom sound; image and sound play independently. GM-client-only to avoid duplicate/overlapping sounds across connected players. Two separate settings menus: Global Settings and Per-Character Setup (drag-and-drop or paste an Actor UUID, no giant actor dropdown).
